Fill in the GMS1 for your daughter as follows. After mdoc restores the values, make any adjustments by hand and write text entries in block capitals.

| Box | Entry | What to check or complete by hand |
|---|---|---|
| B01 | NEEDS-YOU | Tick the title you use for your daughter. |
| B02 | RAGHUNATHAN | |
| B03 | 17/09/2019 | If your copy specifies a date format, adjust the restored date by hand. |
| B04 | ANIKA | Add any other given names she has. |
| B05 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her NHS number if known. A first GP registration does not establish whether she already has one. |
| B06 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter any previous surnames. Leave blank if she has had none. |
| B07 | ✓ Female | |
| B08 | MANCHESTER, U.K. | Check that the restored entry includes both the town and country of birth. Add either part if missing. |
| B09 | 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom | Use the home address you share. |
| B10 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the home postcode. If it appears in the restored address, copy it into this box. |
| B11 | +44 7700 900123 | Use your number as her parent contact. |
| B12 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her previous UK address if she had one. |
| B13 | Leave blank | This is her first GP registration. |
| B14 | Leave blank | This is her first GP registration. |
| B15 | 14 Quillon Mews, Didsbury, Manchester M20 6QX, United Kingdom | If the “from abroad” section applies, use her current address for this first UK GP registration. |
| B16 | NEEDS-YOU | If she previously lived in the UK and then left, enter the date she left. |
| B17 | NEEDS-YOU | If the “from abroad” section applies, enter the date she first came to live in the UK. |
| B18 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her address before enlisting only if she is returning from the Armed Forces. |
| B19 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her service or personnel number only if she is returning from the Armed Forces. |
| B20 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her enlistment date only if she is returning from the Armed Forces. |
| B21 | NEEDS-YOU | Tick only if she is under five and you want to register her for Child Health Surveillance. |
| B22 | NEEDS-YOU | Tick either statement that applies if you need the GP to dispense medicines or appliances. |
| B23 | ✓ Signature on behalf of patient | Sign by hand. |
| B24 | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the date you sign. |
